event_name: Date 23 June 2018 Time 09:48 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 17), request that the driver, the wheel gun operator responsible for the left rear wheel of the car and a team representative report to the Stewards at 11:15 in relation to the incident below.
reason: Alleged breach of Article 28.13 b), car 11 released from a pit stop at 16:39 in an unsafe condition during FP2. The Stewards Garry Connelly Enzo Spano Yannick Dalmas Jean-Marie Krempff
title: 2018 French Grand Prix Summons Car 11 Alleged Release From A Pit Stop In An Unsafe Condition19
